title: Stone Hoes to Spades
description: Changes Stone Hoes to Spades. Both the texture and english language files have been changed.
body:
Changes Stone Hoes to Spades. Both texture and english language files have been changed. All non-joke english language files have been edited to say 'spade' instead of 'stone hoe'.


Images are reused from the planet minecraft bedrock version's page. The pack has been tested on 1.21 java with australian english and it works. I just didnt bother retaking screenshots from java for the java pages.

Let me know if theres any issues with the other languages or in newer versions.
